audience: Sales and estimating at modular and container building manufacturers
headline: Modular quotes still wait on the estimator?
symptoms: Every quote goes through one person's spreadsheet
Options that can't be built together get quoted anyway
Prices drift away from the cost workbook
build: A quoting tool that builds a rule-checked, itemized quote in minutes from your own cost workbook. Nothing reaches the customer until the estimator approves it.

screens.caption: Inbound inquiries, one click to quote
Estimator review before anything goes out
Customer quote letter, no margins shown
